name: Daikin Madoka BRC1H A/C
description: Daikin Madoka BRC1H: UART-over-BLE thermostat protocol. Observer fingerprint, peripheral simulator, and central on/off/mode/setpoint control.
author: BLESPloit
notes: Advertises 128-bit UCG UART service 2141e110-… plus manufacturer 0x0093 / E000. Runtime control is Write Without Response on 2141e112 and Notify on 2141e111; PDUs are 20-byte UART chunks wrapping a 16-bit BE function ID (bit 14 = SET) and TLV parameters. Using that protocol requires pairing, including confirmation on the unit (peripheral sim does not require pairing). Bonding probe is GET 0x0000 (wire 00000000). UUG service 2141e100-… is the UEI BLE-module OTA channel.

scripts.title: Get Madoka status
scripts.hint: Reads power, mode, setpoint, and temperatures. Requires pairing.
